title: CSOAI connector envelope v0
description: The one minimal typed record every collector emits before verify/quarantine/sign/root (issue #2391, 'Common connector envelope'). An envelope points at an artifact by its sha256; any measured value lives in those hashed bytes, never in prose around them. lifecycle_state reuses the estate's existing words: INDEXED is not MEASURED, and an envelope does not sign, root, publish, or write the board. Measurement, not certification. Rules a JSON Schema engine cannot express (idempotency_key recomputation) are enforced by scripts/adapters/connector_envelope.py, which is the reference validator.

url.description: The upstream endpoint or page the connector read.

revision.description: Version, digest, or revision as published by the source. null means the source did not publish one; it is never guessed.

measurement_kind.description: The measurement family the subject belongs to, from functions/api/_gspc_types.ts. lifecycle_state says how far along that family the subject actually got.

sha256.description: sha256 of the artifact bytes. null only when no bytes were obtained (error envelopes); never null for PROBED, MEASURED, SIGNED or ROOTED.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the row inside the artifact, when the subject is one row of a larger file.

observed_at.description: UTC time the source was observed, taken from the artifact. Never the time the envelope was written.

license.description: SPDX id or source license string, or the literal UNCHECKABLE when the source did not publish one.

producer.description: Repo path of the code that emitted the envelope.

producer_revision.description: Content digest of the producer source or its git commit.

measurement.description: Carried only by MEASURED, SIGNED and ROOTED envelopes with an artifact hash and no error. Everything else is null.

error.description: Non-null only for UNMEASURED, UNCHECKABLE or QUARANTINED. An error envelope carries no measurement.

idempotency_key.description: sha256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8) of [source, subject, measurement_kind, artifact.sha256]. Replaying a collector over the same bytes yields the same key.
